name: @atum-labs/ld-data-integrity
description: TypeScript primitives for W3C Data Integrity 1.0 (canonicalize / hash / detached ES256K-R JWS / Ed25519Signature2020 multibase). Sibling of the Go data-integrity library; both halves MUST stay byte-equal on canonical n-quads or the cross-language signing round trip breaks.

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.pretest: node scripts/copy-context.mjs && mkdir -p src/contexts && cp dist/contexts/*.jsonld src/contexts/
